issues.detail: The Hebrew 'רוּחַ הַצָּפוֹן' means 'the north wind' or 'the north side' (literally 'spirit/wind of the north'), but the Chinese renders it as '北方的靈' (spirit of the north), which changes the meaning from a directional/geographical reference to a spiritual entity. The context (measuring the temple area) indicates it refers to the north side, not a spirit.
